engine: r1864's section media-reveal — an ARCHED / OVAL mask over a photo that REVEALS by ANIMATING the mask GEOMETRY on section enter: it starts as a thin centred vertical SLIT and GROWS outward into a full arch (rounded/pointed top + soft-oval bottom), unveiling the photo within; the media does a gentle scale-settle + parallax inside; a kicker + serif title settle over/under it. The 'a window opens onto the surroundings' reveal. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18644 /location ОКРУЖЕНИЕ + the heritage arched-window imagery).

measured_teardown.move: scroll-into-view reveal, p 0..1, PURE set(p). The mask opens via clip-path inset() with per-corner rounding (big TOP radii = the arch crown, soft BOTTOM radii = the oval foot) in two overlapping stages: stage 1 (0..0.55) horizontal slit -> full width (left/right inset 50%->0); stage 2 vertical -> full height with the BOTTOM lagging (top inset 0.20..0.78, bottom 0.30..0.85) so it reads as a RISING arch. The inner media scales mediaScaleFrom(1.12)->1 + a small parallax translateY over 0..0.85. The kicker fades 0.55..0.75; the serif title fades + translateY 26->0 over 0.65..1.0. ease power3.out per channel.
measured_teardown.cited: r18644 /location ОКРУЖЕНИЕ: a full-bleed surroundings photo with a quatrefoil ornament + serif title; the r1864 family frames heritage/architecture imagery in arched windows / arches. The reveal animates the arch open.

archTop.what: top corner-radius — the arch crown (higher = rounder/pointier crown).

mediaScaleFrom.what: inner media's starting scale; settles to 1 as it reveals.

parallax.what: inner media's settle parallax (translateY) during the reveal.

once.what: play once or reset on leave-back.

pin.what: pin the stage so the arch holds while it opens.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.
